correctness.rationale: For all integers s>=2 and t>=0 the center-hit probability at j leaves is j/(j+1) for one step and 1/(j+1) for zero steps. Star survival is iff center attachment, with nonstar graph irreversibly containing a four-vertex path; thus iterated conditional probabilities yield the exact product. Telescoping gives q=0 and q=1 boundaries, gamma-product identity for 0<q<1; the factored survival s/(s+t) times product (1-q(1-1/j)) gives geometric upper/lower bounds and fixed-s E[tau]~s log(1/q). Taking t=floor(sx), s q_s->lambda yields continuous e^(-lambda x)/(1+x), while t=floor(x/q_s), q_s->0, s q_s->infinity yields Exp(1), with logarithmic error terms controlled. The source verifier was inspected line by line; independent exact graph-state enumerations and gamma/bound checks (3625 independent rational assertions) corroborate finite cases only. The q=0 formula is mathematically correct but previously known, and proof correctness is not claimed to establish novelty.
